name: day_volume_ratio
hypothesis: Log ratio of today's cumulative volume since midnight to the same weekday's typical cumulative (previous 4 weeks): a whole-day anomaly the 3 h input window cannot see
code:
def feature(ctx):
    raw = ctx["raw"]; T, N = raw.shape; D = ctx["STEPS_PER_DAY"]
    days = T // D
    cum = np.cumsum(raw[: days * D].reshape(days, D, N), axis=1)
    typ = np.zeros_like(cum)
    for k in range(1, 5):
        typ[7 * k:] += cum[: -7 * k]
    ratio = np.log((cum + 20) / (typ / 4 + 20))
    ratio[:28] = 0
    out = np.zeros((T, N), dtype=np.float32); out[: days * D] = ratio.reshape(-1, N)
    return out

name: docklands_leave
hypothesis: AFL crowd leaving Docklands (Marvel Stadium), 2.5-4 h after the start; fans heading to the eastern suburbs pass Victoria St / Barkers Rd
code:
def feature(ctx):
    t = ctx["times"]; ev = ctx["events"]; ev = ev[ev.kind == "afl_docklands"]
    out = np.zeros(len(t), dtype=np.float32)
    a = t.searchsorted(ev.start + pd.Timedelta(hours=2.5)); b = t.searchsorted(ev.start + pd.Timedelta(hours=4))
    for i, j, c in zip(a, b, ev.crowd.to_numpy()):
        out[i:j] = np.maximum(out[i:j], c / 1e5)
    return out

name: docklands_arrive
hypothesis: AFL crowd travelling to Docklands, 2 h before the start
code:
def feature(ctx):
    t = ctx["times"]; ev = ctx["events"]; ev = ev[ev.kind == "afl_docklands"]
    out = np.zeros(len(t), dtype=np.float32)
    a = t.searchsorted(ev.start + pd.Timedelta(hours=-2)); b = t.searchsorted(ev.start + pd.Timedelta(hours=0))
    for i, j, c in zip(a, b, ev.crowd.to_numpy()):
        out[i:j] = np.maximum(out[i:j], c / 1e5)
